args.body: Take BERLIN-MAPPING-OFFLINE-QA. Preserve the observed missing OSM account and outgoing channel; they block live edits and applications. description: The geospatial rejection leaves one material uncertainty: the buyer separately requested mapping workers and a bicycle photographer, while the formal project specification was unread.
